concept: 은꼴사에 초점을 맞춰서 컨셉 만들어서 다시 한번 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 테스트해줘.
negative_en: plastic-looking skin, excessive HDR, illustration look, 3D render look, body distortion, broken facial features, over-processed retouching, distorted fingers
prompt_en: Create a vertical photorealistic fashion editorial in a late-night independent boutique fitting salon between appointments, built around an ordinary adult fashion-adjustment event with a visible causal boundary change. Image 1 is an appearance reference only: carry visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and visible natural skin texture into an original adult fashion portrait. Show one unmistakably adult woman from head to upper thighs. One unmistakably adult subject remains the visible actor, a mature boutique client wearing the complete outfit from face through upper thighs. One unmistakably adult fashion subject wears the complete layered outfit, shown head to upper thighs in a mature boutique editorial. A constructed bralette camisole slip or bodysuit forms the visible foundation layer, realized as an opaque ivory satin camisole with bound straps, squared neckline, bust seams, and lower hem. A separate blazer shirt cardigan trouser or skirt layer remains clearly present, realized as a midnight-navy tailored linen-silk suit jacket with lapels, front edges, lining, and button. Layer order intersections hems straps lapels and closures remain physically traceable, with contact shadows separating the ivory camisole and navy jacket at neckline and waist. A concrete unfinished dressing grooming or room task remains self-directed as her right thumb and forefinger lift the jacket's left waist edge before release. Her right thumb and forefinger lift the precise waist-height corner of the jacket's left front edge to settle its overlap, paused before release. One stable opaque or layered edge creates a traceable reveal-and-coverage boundary: the navy jacket's left front waist corner lifts above the ivory camisole hem. The visible hand action physically changes or holds that exact garment boundary, with thumb and forefinger lifting the same left-front corner that opens the waist interval. The boundary reveals a bounded shoulder collarbone side back or clearly distinct foundation-layer relation, realized here as one narrow diagonal waist interval above the trouser waistband. Face action torso and environmental context remain readable in one holistic frame, from her adult face through hand, torso, acrylic screen, and boutique room. Fabric weight overlap contact shadow and gravity explain the coverage relation, including satin hem, linen-silk lapel, lifted corner, lining, and cast shadow. Face and the changed boundary are the first two readable focal relations at thumbnail scale, with the lifted left-front corner larger than the background reflection. Closing or removing that boundary would erase the controlled reveal proposition from the photograph, because the narrow waist interval closes while the foundation remains separate. Editorial lookbook backstage or public styling context keeps the image fashion-led, realized as an after-hours boutique fitting portrait between appointments. Place a transparent acrylic garment screen crossed by one reflected ceiling strip behind her, keeping the real face, real hand, torso, garment edges, and contact shadows optically traceable. Use diffuse rainy daylight with one warm practical glow, eye-level vertical framing, and a 55 mm lens; preserve realistic satin sheen, linen-silk grain, seam relief, overlap direction, contact shadow, and natural skin texture. Avoid: plastic-looking skin, excessive HDR, illustration look, 3D render look, body distortion, broken facial features, over-processed retouching, distorted fingers
